derived_K_at_q_100_percent.derivation: K = min K with C(N-D,K)/C(N,K) <= 1/100, D = D_min(N) = min(N, max(1, ceil(N*0.1))); exact rationals; README example N=1000 -> K=43 reproduced. Same definition as palw_detection_k_min_v1 (which never returns below the exact minimum).
derived_K_at_q_100_percent.note: q < 0.99 cannot reach 99% total detection whatever K; q is unmeasured, so no production K is derived.
